abstract_evidence_excerpt: Here, we show that a transcription factor SufR (Rv1460) senses NO via its 4Fe-4S cluster and promotes persistence of Mtb by mobilizing the Fe-S cluster biogenesis system; suf operon (Rv1460-Rv1466). Atmospheric O2 and H2O2 gradually degrade the 4Fe-4S cluster of SufR.
